title: Spaghetti Aglio e Olio
description: Spaghetti tossed with garlic, chili flakes, olive oil, and parsley.

steps.instruction: Boil 2 liters of water with 1 tablespoon salt. Add 200 grams of spaghetti and cook until al dente, about 10 minutes.
Reserve 1 cup of pasta water, then drain the spaghetti.
In a pan, heat 3 tablespoons of olive oil on low flame. Add 6 sliced garlic cloves and 1 teaspoon chili flakes. Cook gently for 3 minutes until garlic is fragrant but not browned.
Add the drained spaghetti to the pan with a splash of pasta water. Toss well for 2 minutes.
Stir in 2 tablespoons of chopped parsley and serve immediately.

title: Margherita Pizza
description: Naples-style pizza with tomato sauce, fresh mozzarella, and basil.

steps.instruction: Preheat the oven to 250 degrees Celsius (or as high as it goes) with a pizza stone for 30 minutes.
Blanch 3 tomatoes, peel, and crush into a coarse sauce. Add 0.5 teaspoon salt.
Stretch 250 grams of pizza dough into a 25 cm round on a floured surface.
Spread 3 tablespoons of tomato sauce over the dough, leaving a 2 cm border.
Tear 125 grams of fresh mozzarella and distribute evenly. Drizzle 1 tablespoon olive oil.
Bake on the preheated stone for 8 to 10 minutes until the crust is charred and the cheese is bubbling.
Top with 8 fresh basil leaves and serve immediately.

title: Beef Tacos
description: Soft tortillas filled with seasoned beef, salsa, and lime.

steps.instruction: Heat 1 tablespoon of oil in a pan. Add 1 chopped onion and 3 crushed garlic cloves. Saute for 3 minutes.
Add 400 grams of ground beef. Cook, breaking it up, for 8 minutes until browned.
Stir in 1 teaspoon cumin powder, 1 teaspoon paprika, and 1 teaspoon salt. Cook for 2 minutes.
Warm 8 tortillas in a dry pan for 30 seconds each side.
Fill each tortilla with beef, top with chopped tomato, coriander leaves, and a squeeze of lime.

steps.instruction: Japanese style. Heat 1 tablespoon of oil in a pan. Add 1 chopped onion and 3 crushed garlic cloves. Saute for 3 minutes.
Add 400 grams of ground beef. Cook, breaking it up, for 8 minutes until browned.
Stir in 1 teaspoon cumin powder, 1 teaspoon paprika, and 1 teaspoon salt. Cook for 2 minutes.
Warm 8 tortillas in a dry pan for 30 seconds each side.
Fill each tortilla with beef, top with chopped tomato, coriander leaves, and a squeeze of lime.

title: Pad Thai
description: Stir-fried rice noodles with tamarind sauce, peanuts, and lime.

steps.instruction: Soak 150 grams of rice noodles in warm water for 20 minutes until pliable. Drain.
Mix 2 tablespoons tamarind concentrate, 2 tablespoons fish sauce, and 1 tablespoon palm sugar. Set aside.
Heat 2 tablespoons of oil in a wok on high. Add 3 crushed garlic cloves and 2 chopped shallots. Stir-fry for 1 minute.
Add 150 grams of shrimp and stir-fry for 2 minutes until pink.
Push everything to one side. Crack 2 eggs into the empty side and scramble for 1 minute.
Add the drained noodles and the tamarind sauce. Toss everything together for 3 minutes until the noodles absorb the sauce.
Stir in 3 tablespoons of crushed peanuts and 1 teaspoon chili flakes. Serve with lime wedges.

title: Vegetable Fried Rice
description: Wok-tossed rice with mixed vegetables, soy sauce, and sesame oil.

steps.instruction: Cook 2 cups of rice with 4 cups of water until just done, about 12 minutes. Spread on a tray to cool completely.
Heat 2 tablespoons of oil in a wok on high. Add 3 crushed garlic cloves and stir-fry for 30 seconds.
Add 1 diced carrot, 0.5 cup chopped beans, 0.5 cup peas. Stir-fry for 3 minutes.
Add the cooled rice and toss well for 3 minutes until heated through.
Pour 2 tablespoons of soy sauce and 1 teaspoon sesame oil over the rice. Toss for 1 minute.
Top with chopped spring onion and serve hot.

title: Caesar Salad
description: Crisp romaine lettuce with croutons, parmesan, and creamy Caesar dressing.

steps.instruction: Preheat the oven to 180 degrees Celsius. Cut 2 slices of bread into cubes, toss with 2 tablespoons olive oil and a pinch of salt, and bake for 8 minutes until crisp.
In a bowl, whisk 2 egg yolks, 1 teaspoon mustard, 2 crushed garlic cloves, and the juice of 1 lemon.
Slowly whisk in 3 tablespoons of olive oil until emulsified. Stir in 30 grams of grated parmesan, 0.5 teaspoon salt, and 0.5 teaspoon black pepper.
Tear 1 head of romaine lettuce into bite-size pieces.
Toss the lettuce with the dressing, croutons, and remaining parmesan. Serve immediately.

title: Sushi Roll (Maki)
description: Vinegared rice and nori rolled with fresh fish or vegetables.

steps.instruction: Rinse 1.5 cups of sushi rice until the water runs clear. Cook with 2 cups of water for 15 minutes. Let rest for 10 minutes.
Warm 3 tablespoons of rice vinegar with 2 teaspoons of sugar and 0.5 teaspoon salt until dissolved. Fold gently into the cooked rice. Cool to room temperature.
Place a sheet of nori on a bamboo mat. Spread a thin layer of rice over the nori, leaving a 2 cm strip at the top.
Arrange strips of cucumber, avocado, and salmon along the bottom edge of the rice.
Roll tightly from the bottom, dampening the top strip with water to seal. Repeat for 4 rolls.
Cut each roll into 8 pieces with a sharp, wet knife. Serve with soy sauce and wasabi.

Place a sheet of nori on a bamboo mat. Spread a thin layer of rice over the nori, leaving a 2 cm strip at the top.
Arrange strips of cucumber, avocado, and salmon along the bottom edge of the rice.
Roll tightly from the bottom, dampening the top strip with water to seal. Repeat for 4 rolls.
Cut each roll into 8 pieces with a sharp, wet knife. Serve with soy sauce and wasabi.

title: Greek Salad
description: Tomato, cucumber, olives, and feta with olive oil and oregano.

steps.instruction: Cut 4 tomatoes into wedges, slice 1 cucumber into thick rounds, and thinly slice half a red onion.
Combine the vegetables in a bowl with 0.5 cup of kalamata olives.
Whisk 3 tablespoons of olive oil with the juice of 1 lemon, 1 teaspoon dried oregano, and 0.5 teaspoon salt.
Pour the dressing over the vegetables and toss gently.
Top with a 150-gram slab of feta cheese, sprinkle with extra oregano, and serve.

title: Beef Burger
description: Juicy beef patty with lettuce, tomato, and cheese in a soft bun.

steps.instruction: Divide 500 grams of ground beef into 4 equal portions. Shape each into a patty about 1.5 cm thick. Season both sides with 1 teaspoon salt and 0.5 teaspoon black pepper.
Heat a heavy pan or grill on high. Lightly oil the surface. Cook the patties for 3 minutes per side for medium.
Top each patty with a slice of cheddar in the last minute so it melts.
Toast the burger buns cut-side down in the same pan for 30 seconds.
Build the burgers: bottom bun, lettuce, tomato slices, patty with cheese, onion slices, top bun. Serve hot.

title: Pancakes
description: Fluffy American-style breakfast pancakes with maple syrup.

steps.instruction: Whisk 1.5 cups flour, 2 tablespoons sugar, 2 teaspoons baking powder, and 0.5 teaspoon salt in a bowl.
In another bowl, whisk 1.25 cups milk, 1 egg, and 3 tablespoons melted butter. Combine with the dry ingredients until just mixed.
Heat a non-stick pan on medium. Pour 0.25 cup batter per pancake. Cook for 2 minutes per side until golden.
Serve warm with maple syrup and butter.

title: Tom Yum Soup
description: Thai hot and sour soup with shrimp, lemongrass, and lime leaves.

steps.instruction: Bring 4 cups of water to a boil with 2 crushed lemongrass stalks, 5 slices of galangal, and 4 kaffir lime leaves. Simmer for 5 minutes.
Add 150 grams of sliced mushrooms and 1 teaspoon chili flakes. Simmer for 5 minutes.
Add 200 grams of shrimp and 2 tablespoons fish sauce. Cook for 3 minutes until shrimp turn pink.
Remove from heat. Squeeze in the juice of 1 lime and stir in 2 tablespoons chopped coriander.
Serve hot.

title: French Onion Soup
description: Caramelized onion broth topped with toasted bread and melted gruyere.

steps.instruction: Thinly slice 4 onions. Heat 3 tablespoons of butter and 1 tablespoon of olive oil in a heavy pot. Add the onions and cook on medium-low for 30 minutes, stirring occasionally, until deeply caramelized.
Add 4 cups of beef broth, 1 teaspoon thyme, 0.5 teaspoon salt, and 0.5 teaspoon black pepper. Simmer for 15 minutes.
Preheat the broiler. Ladle the soup into oven-safe bowls. Top each with a slice of bread and 25 grams of grated gruyere.
Broil for 2 minutes until the cheese is bubbly and golden. Serve immediately.

steps.instruction: Mediterranean style. Thinly slice 4 onions. Heat 3 tablespoons of butter and 1 tablespoon of olive oil in a heavy pot. Add the onions and cook on medium-low for 30 minutes, stirring occasionally, until deeply caramelized.
Add 4 cups of beef broth, 1 teaspoon thyme, 0.5 teaspoon salt, and 0.5 teaspoon black pepper. Simmer for 15 minutes.
Preheat the broiler. Ladle the soup into oven-safe bowls. Top each with a slice of bread and 25 grams of grated gruyere.
Broil for 2 minutes until the cheese is bubbly and golden. Serve immediately.

title: Shakshuka
description: Eggs poached in a spiced tomato and pepper sauce.

steps.instruction: Heat 2 tablespoons of olive oil in a skillet. Add 1 chopped onion, 1 diced bell pepper, and 4 crushed garlic cloves. Saute for 5 minutes.
Add 5 chopped tomatoes, 1 teaspoon cumin powder, 1 teaspoon paprika, and 1 teaspoon salt. Cook for 12 minutes until thick.
Make 4 wells in the sauce with a spoon. Crack an egg into each well.
Cover and cook on low for 6 minutes until the egg whites are set but the yolks are still runny.
Crumble 50 grams of feta on top, sprinkle with coriander, and serve with crusty bread.

title: Tzatziki
description: Greek yogurt dip with cucumber, garlic, and dill.

steps.instruction: Grate 1 cucumber and squeeze out the excess water.
Mix 2 cups of strained yogurt (curd) with the grated cucumber, 2 crushed garlic cloves, 1 tablespoon olive oil, juice of half a lemon, 1 tablespoon chopped dill, and 0.5 teaspoon salt.
Refrigerate for 1 hour before serving with pita bread or vegetables.

description: Japanese noodle soup in a savory broth with eggs and toppings.

steps.instruction: Soft-boil 2 eggs: place in boiling water for 6 minutes, then cool in ice water and peel.
Heat 1 tablespoon of oil in a pot. Add 4 crushed garlic cloves and 3 cm grated ginger. Saute for 1 minute.
Add 6 cups of water, 200 grams of chicken, 3 tablespoons soy sauce, and 2 tablespoons mirin. Simmer for 25 minutes.
Remove the chicken and shred. Strain the broth.
Cook 200 grams of ramen noodles according to the package, about 3 minutes. Drain.
Divide the noodles into bowls. Pour hot broth over. Top with shredded chicken, halved soft-boiled eggs, and chopped spring onion.

title: Spaghetti Aglio e Olio (ChefMate special 300)
description: Spaghetti tossed with garlic, chili flakes, olive oil, and parsley. ChefMate special version 300.

steps.instruction: Boil 2 liters of water with 1 tablespoon salt. Add 200 grams of spaghetti and cook until al dente, about 10 minutes.
Reserve 1 cup of pasta water, then drain the spaghetti.
In a pan, heat 3 tablespoons of olive oil on low flame. Add 6 sliced garlic cloves and 1 teaspoon chili flakes. Cook gently for 3 minutes until garlic is fragrant but not browned.
Add the drained spaghetti to the pan with a splash of pasta water. Toss well for 2 minutes.
Stir in 2 tablespoons of chopped parsley and serve immediately.

steps.instruction: Thai style. Boil 2 liters of water with 1 tablespoon salt. Add 200 grams of spaghetti and cook until al dente, about 10 minutes.
Reserve 1 cup of pasta water, then drain the spaghetti.
In a pan, heat 3 tablespoons of olive oil on low flame. Add 6 sliced garlic cloves and 1 teaspoon chili flakes. Cook gently for 3 minutes until garlic is fragrant but not browned.
Add the drained spaghetti to the pan with a splash of pasta water. Toss well for 2 minutes.
Stir in 2 tablespoons of chopped parsley and serve immediately.

steps.instruction: Moroccan style. Boil 2 liters of water with 1 tablespoon salt. Add 200 grams of spaghetti and cook until al dente, about 10 minutes.
Reserve 1 cup of pasta water, then drain the spaghetti.
In a pan, heat 3 tablespoons of olive oil on low flame. Add 6 sliced garlic cloves and 1 teaspoon chili flakes. Cook gently for 3 minutes until garlic is fragrant but not browned.
Add the drained spaghetti to the pan with a splash of pasta water. Toss well for 2 minutes.
Stir in 2 tablespoons of chopped parsley and serve immediately.

steps.instruction: Spanish style. Boil 2 liters of water with 1 tablespoon salt. Add 200 grams of spaghetti and cook until al dente, about 10 minutes.
Reserve 1 cup of pasta water, then drain the spaghetti.
In a pan, heat 3 tablespoons of olive oil on low flame. Add 6 sliced garlic cloves and 1 teaspoon chili flakes. Cook gently for 3 minutes until garlic is fragrant but not browned.
Add the drained spaghetti to the pan with a splash of pasta water. Toss well for 2 minutes.
Stir in 2 tablespoons of chopped parsley and serve immediately.
